summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Maris-Tech Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its Annual and Special General Meeting of Shareholders held on August 17, 2026. Shareholders approved seven routine proposals: re-appointment of independent auditor Kost, Forer, Gabbay Kasierer; re-appointment of two Class II directors; approval of a one-time bonus and annual bonus plan for the Chairman; and grants of equity-based compensation to non-executive directors, the CEO, and the Chairman. No special-situation event, transaction, or disruption is present. This is a standard meeting-results disclosure.
